CURRENT 10–12 retain the principal stepped composition and show clearly recessed tower balconies with side returns, soffits and glass guards. The darker lower zone itself should remain. Terrace connections appear continuous; these captures do not establish concealed slab-wall contacts or railing fixings. The removed neighbor and external context remain subject to conflicting recorded intents; their absence does not resolve the old neighbor requirement, and restoration is excluded from this correction.</assessment>
